title: 四季の風景 ドット絵
subject_en: Small landscape vignettes, each a compact diorama on its own rounded ground patch (not a full-bleed background), retro pixel art with crisp pixels and a 1-pixel dark outline around the whole shape. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters.
lead: 春の桜、夏の海、秋の紅葉、冬の雪。四季の小さな風景を、ゲームのようなドット絵で12点。ブログのアイキャッチやゲーム風デザインに。
items: a small diorama with cherry trees and a path
a small yellow rapeseed field with butterflies
a small beach with waves, a parasol and a cloud
a night hill diorama with colourful fireworks
a small hillside with red and orange maples
a small field with pumpkins and a scarecrow
a small snowy field with a snowman and pine trees
a cosy house with a lit window in snow
a small town corner with puddles and an umbrella
a small town at night with a moon and lit windows
a small mountain with a blue lake
a small farm with a barn and a windmill
